hero.title: LET'S TALK
hero.subtitle: Have an idea? Let's build something extraordinary together.

faqData.a: I build and customise Shopify stores, design and develop fast, responsive websites, and create mobile apps for Android and cross-platform with Flutter. I also run Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad campaigns, so I can help with both building your store and bringing customers to it.

faqData.q: Can you build or redesign my Shopify store?
faqData.a: Yes. I've built and launched Shopify stores for fashion brands like Agedarc and FT Grails, and worked on storefront components for Allbirds. I handle theme setup and customisation with Liquid, custom sections, collections, product pages, apps, and payment setup, all focused on a smooth, high-converting shopping experience.

faqData.q: Do you run Meta ads for online stores?
faqData.a: Yes. I set up and manage Meta ad campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, from pixel and catalog setup to audience targeting, creatives, and ongoing optimisation, so your ads bring in real sales rather than just clicks.

faqData.q: Can you develop mobile apps as well?
faqData.a: Yes. I've built Android apps with Java and Kotlin, and cross-platform apps with Flutter and Dart, backed by Firebase, Django, and REST APIs. One of my apps, UniWay, is live on the Google Play Store.

faqData.q: How can we start working together?
faqData.a: Use the contact form above or email me directly at anjalisharmaaa656@gmail.com. Share a few details about your business and what you need, and I'll usually get back to you within 24 hours with next steps.
